name: arodonata-aibuilder
description: Multi-agent skill, SDK quick-reference, Check Point quirk guides, and verified Python 3.13/uv templates for building Check Point automation scripts with Arodonata v2 and arlogi.
suggestedPrompts: Create a single-file uv script using ArodonataClient, native Asset role/platform classification, and arlogi to inventory gateways and execution targets.
Scaffold a --dry-run MDSM CPCRUD automation CLI with persistent SQLite caching and offline FileReplayApiMock tests.
Build a Gaia on-box inspection script using ScriptRepositoryService with single-pass cpinfo and safe clish lock handling.
